zh.caption: 圖 1｜同一個 Finance 資料夾，可能有三種不同的結果
zh.description: 三個平行能力，沒有先後箭頭；名稱可見不表示可讀，能讀也不表示能改。

items.title: 看得到名稱
items.body: 知道 Finance 存在

items.title: 讀得到內容
items.body: 可以開啟財務報表

items.title: 改得了內容
items.body: 可以修改財務報表

en.caption: Figure 1 | Three distinct outcomes for the same Finance folder
en.description: These are parallel capabilities, without sequence arrows. Seeing a name does not grant reading; reading does not grant modification.

items.title: See the name
items.body: Know that Finance exists

items.title: Read the contents
items.body: Open financial statements

items.title: Modify the contents
items.body: Change financial statements

zh.caption: 圖 2｜一個使用者想讀取伺服器資料
zh.description: 箭頭表示依序檢查四個問題。這是理解用的示意圖；實際協定不一定依這四步執行，傳輸保護也可能在登入前建立。

items.title: 第一關：網路可達性
items.body:
防火牆讓不讓你連到這個服務？

像大樓外面的圍牆和入口。

items.title: 第二關：身分驗證 Authentication
items.body:
系統能不能確認你是誰？

像櫃檯核對員工證件。

items.title: 第三關：存取授權 Authorization
items.body:
就算你是員工，你能看哪些文件、做哪些操作？

像確認你有沒有財務室的鑰匙。

items.title: 第四項：傳輸保護 Encryption / Integrity
items.body:
資料在傳送途中有沒有被偷看或竄改？

像用上鎖、防拆封的公事包運送文件。

en.caption: Figure 2 | A user wants to read server data
en.description: Arrows indicate the order of these explanatory checks. Actual protocols need not execute in this sequence; transport protection can be established before login.

items.title: Check 1: Network reachability
items.body:
Does the firewall allow a connection to this service?

Like the building perimeter and entrance.

items.title: Check 2: Authentication
items.body:
Can the system establish who you are?

Like reception checking an employee ID.

items.title: Check 3: Authorization
items.body:
Even as an employee, which documents may you see and which operations may you perform?

Like checking whether you have a key to Finance.

items.title: Item 4: Encryption / Integrity
items.body:
Is data protected against observation or tampering in transit?

Like carrying files in a locked, tamper-evident briefcase.

zh.caption: 圖 3｜模擬驗收：財務資料的存取權限
zh.description: 教學案例：以下皆為合成測試結果。切換身分，對照政策與觀察；固定假設是普通員工存在越權讀取，另外兩個案例符合各自受測操作的政策。沒有連線或實際登入，也不代表整台系統已通過驗收。

items.title: 外部訪客
items.body:
政策預期：不能讀公告或財務資料

實際觀察：公告與財務資料均拒絕讀取

受測操作符合政策

仍須核對核准員工的正常業務功能。

items.title: 普通員工
items.body:
政策預期：能讀公告，但不能讀財務資料

實際觀察：公告可讀，但也能開啟薪資清單

發現不符合政策的行為

發現越權讀取，應檢查檔案與群組的有效權限。

items.title: 財務人員
items.body:
政策預期：能讀公告及財務資料

實際觀察：公告與財務資料均可讀

受測操作符合政策

這只驗證讀取；修改與刪除權限須另依政策測試。

en.caption: Figure 3 | Simulated acceptance: access to financial data
en.description: Teaching scenario: all results are synthetic. Select an identity to compare policy with observation. The fixed assumption is excessive access for the ordinary employee; the other two cases meet policy for their tested operations. No connections or real logins occur, and these cases do not establish whole-system acceptance.

items.title: External guest
items.body:
Expected policy: cannot read announcements or financial data

Observed: both reads denied

Tested operations match policy

Still check normal business functions for approved employees.

items.title: Ordinary employee
items.body:
Expected policy: can read announcements, but not financial data

Observed: announcements readable, but the salary list also opens

Behavior violates policy

Investigate effective file and group permissions for the excessive read access.

items.title: Finance staff
items.body:
Expected policy: can read announcements and financial data

Observed: both are readable

Tested operations match policy

This tests reading only; test modification and deletion separately against policy.
